मैया जय शैलपुत्री माता।

करुणामयी जगजननी

snippet.title: दि एक्सॉर्सिस्ट: मार्टर्स'(The Exorcist: Martyrs) | Official Hindi Trailer
snippet.description:
In cinemas March 12
Follow us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/UniversalPicturesIndia/
Find us on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/universalpicturesindia/
Follow us on Twitter at https://x.com/UniversalIND 

Director: Mike Flanagan  
Written by: Mike Flanagan 
Based on characters created by William Peter Blatty  
Producers: David Robinson, Jason Blum, Mike Flanagan  
Executive Producers: Alexandra Magistro, Ryan Turek  

Cast: Scarlett Johansson, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Diane Lane, Jacobi Jupe, Sasha  Calle, Scoot McNairy, Gil Bellows with Laurence Fishburne and John Leguizamo 

Academy Award®️ nominee Scarlett Johansson fronts The Exorcist: Martyrs, an unsettling new chapter in one of the most storied titles in cinema history from genre auteur Mike Flanagan, the creator of  acclaimed series The Haunting of Hill House, The Fall of the House of Usher, Midnight Mass, and the  upcoming Carrie, as well as the films Doctor Sleep, The Life of Chuck, Hush and Gerald’s Game. 

Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller (Johansson) ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy’s blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.  

Aided by former prison chaplain Father William (Academy Award®️ nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor), who heard Father Sunday’s final confession, and sharp rookie detective Gina Restrepo (Sasha Calle, The Rip), Detective Miller will discover a filament linking a lineage of serial killers, from H.H. Holmes to the Zodiac, that could corrupt everything, and everyone, she loves with an evil that goes well beyond the mortal.  

The top-flight cast includes Academy Award®️ nominee Diane Lane as Mary, Detective Miller’s mother, who has moved in with her to help raise her grandson Max (Jacobi Jupe, Hamnet); Actor Award winner Scoot McNairy (Argo) as paroled convict Clay Silver; Emmy winner Gil Bellows (Carrie) as Peter Nicks, a former acolyte of Father Sunday; Emmy and Tony winning screen legend Laurence Fishburne as revered priest Father Nichol; and acclaimed star of The Odyssey, Emmy and Special Tony Award winner John Leguizamo, in the most menacing role of his career as Father Sunday.

The Exorcist: Martyrs is written and directed by Mike Flanagan, based on characters created by William Peter Blatty. The film is produced by David Robinson (The Exorcist series, Dead Ringers series), three time Academy Award®️ nominee Jason Blum (Get Out, Black Phone films) and Mike Flanagan. The film is executive produced by Alexandra Magistro and Ryan Turek.

Academy Award®️ nominee Scarlett Johansson fronts The Exorcist: Martyrs, an unsettling new chapter in one of the most storied titles in cinema history from genre auteur Mike Flanagan, the creator of  acclaimed series The Haunting of Hill House, The Fall of the House of Usher, Midnight Mass, and the  upcoming Carrie, as well as the films Doctor Sleep, The Life of Chuck, Hush and Gerald’s Game. 

Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller (Johansson) ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy’s blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.  

Aided by former prison chaplain Father William (Academy Award®️ nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor), who heard Father Sunday’s final confession, and sharp rookie detective Gina Restrepo (Sasha Calle, The Rip), Detective Miller will discover a filament linking a lineage of serial killers, from H.H. Holmes to the Zodiac, that could corrupt everything, and everyone, she loves with an evil that goes well beyond the mortal.  

The top-flight cast includes Academy Award®️ nominee Diane Lane as Mary, Detective Miller’s mother, who has moved in with her to help raise her grandson Max (Jacobi Jupe, Hamnet); Actor Award winner Scoot McNairy (Argo) as paroled convict Clay Silver; Emmy winner Gil Bellows (Carrie) as Peter Nicks, a former acolyte of Father Sunday; Emmy and Tony winning screen legend Laurence Fishburne as revered priest Father Nichol; and acclaimed star of The Odyssey, Emmy and Special Tony Award winner John Leguizamo, in the most menacing role of his career as Father Sunday.

The Exorcist: Martyrs is written and directed by Mike Flanagan, based on characters created by William Peter Blatty. The film is produced by David Robinson (The Exorcist series, Dead Ringers series), three time Academy Award®️ nominee Jason Blum (Get Out, Black Phone films) and Mike Flanagan. The film is executive produced by Alexandra Magistro and Ryan Turek.

snippet.title: JAILER 2 Teaser & Trailer Reaction! | Rajinikanth | S. J. Suryah | Mithun Chakraborty | Vidya Balan
snippet.description:
Jaby and Brandon react to the teaser and trailer of **JAILER 2**, the highly anticipated sequel starring Superstar Rajinikanth! The Tiger is back, and the first glimpses of this next chapter promise an exciting mix of intense action, larger-than-life moments, and intriguing new characters. With plenty of details to unpack and so many questions about what's coming next for Muthuvel Pandian, Jaby and Brandon dive into the footage to share their thoughts, reactions, and excitement for what's shaping up to be another major cinematic event!

*Jailer 2* brings together an impressive ensemble cast led by Rajinikanth (*Jailer, Enthiran, Sivaji*), alongside S. J. Suryah (*Mersal, Maanaadu, Mark Antony*), Mithun Chakraborty (*Disco Dancer, Agneepath, Guru*), Suraj Venjaramoodu (*Driving Licence, Android Kunjappan Version 5.25, The Great Indian Kitchen*), Ramya Krishnan (*Baahubali: The Beginning, Baahubali 2: The Conclusion, Padayappa*), and Vidya Balan (*Kahaani, The Dirty Picture, Bhool Bhulaiyaa*). With such a talented lineup of established stars from across Indian cinema, the sequel promises an exciting combination of screen presence, memorable performances, and larger-than-life entertainment.

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar (*Jailer, Doctor, Beast*), *Jailer 2* sees Rajinikanth return as the iconic Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. With Anirudh Ravichander returning to deliver the music, anticipation is high to see how the sequel builds on the action, dark humor, and unforgettable moments that made the original *Jailer* such a hit. Will the next chapter take things to an entirely new level? Join Jaby and Brandon as they break down the teaser and trailer and share their reactions to one of the most anticipated films in Indian cinema!

localized.description:
Jaby and Brandon react to the teaser and trailer of **JAILER 2**, the highly anticipated sequel starring Superstar Rajinikanth! The Tiger is back, and the first glimpses of this next chapter promise an exciting mix of intense action, larger-than-life moments, and intriguing new characters. With plenty of details to unpack and so many questions about what's coming next for Muthuvel Pandian, Jaby and Brandon dive into the footage to share their thoughts, reactions, and excitement for what's shaping up to be another major cinematic event!

*Jailer 2* brings together an impressive ensemble cast led by Rajinikanth (*Jailer, Enthiran, Sivaji*), alongside S. J. Suryah (*Mersal, Maanaadu, Mark Antony*), Mithun Chakraborty (*Disco Dancer, Agneepath, Guru*), Suraj Venjaramoodu (*Driving Licence, Android Kunjappan Version 5.25, The Great Indian Kitchen*), Ramya Krishnan (*Baahubali: The Beginning, Baahubali 2: The Conclusion, Padayappa*), and Vidya Balan (*Kahaani, The Dirty Picture, Bhool Bhulaiyaa*). With such a talented lineup of established stars from across Indian cinema, the sequel promises an exciting combination of screen presence, memorable performances, and larger-than-life entertainment.

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar (*Jailer, Doctor, Beast*), *Jailer 2* sees Rajinikanth return as the iconic Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. With Anirudh Ravichander returning to deliver the music, anticipation is high to see how the sequel builds on the action, dark humor, and unforgettable moments that made the original *Jailer* such a hit. Will the next chapter take things to an entirely new level? Join Jaby and Brandon as they break down the teaser and trailer and share their reactions to one of the most anticipated films in Indian cinema!

If you are looking for a comedy short film and family entertainer set against the backdrop of this ritualistic period, you are likely referring to the widely-trending sketches and 3D animated comedy shorts that surface during this season.
Because Pitru Paksha is traditionally a solemn period for honoring ancestors, comedy creators use the unique, everyday cultural quirks of Indian families during these 16 days to create hilarious, lighthearted family entertainment.
Here is a general description of what these highly popular Pitru Paksha comedy family short films entail:

🎬 Typical Plot & Setting

The story usually revolves around a traditional middle-class Indian household trying to strictly follow the rules of Shradh (ancestral rituals). The comedy stems from the generational gap between tech-savvy, modern kids and superstitious or strict elders who are anxious about making a mistake.

snippet.description:
I-Popstar Hindi Vol. 2 is streaming on Alright TV app and Netflix

New Episodes Every Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday on Alright TV app at 08:00 PM! Watch Now: https://alrighttv.go.link/9AuBt

New Episodes Every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday on Netflix at 08:00 PM! Watch Now: https://www.netflix.com/search?q=i-popstar&jbv=83190432

👉 Subscribe to Saregama Music: https://bit.ly/3FkAS0W

Credits:

Track Name: Bombay Ki Rani
Singer, Composer, Lyrics: Nishant Mukta
Music Director: Shamir Tandon
Music Supervisor: Ahan Shah
Lyrics Supervisor: Pinky Poonawala
Arranged and programmed by: Muheet Bharti
Mixed and Mastered by : Sachin Nair at Sonic Jungle Studios
Dolby Atmos : Team CFP
Head Mix Engineer - Nikhil Mathew
Assisted by - Abhishek Poojary, Gayatri Karekar, Subhashree Das
Mixes supervised by Sunny M.R. for Chordfather Productions
Vocal Coaches: Bhavya Pandit & Divya S Iyer
Music Operations Head : Tannishtha Puri & Anany Kakade
Audio Post Production: Gopal Thakare
Tech Supervision: Madhur Hatiskar

Lyrics:

VERSE 1
Nasha tohar gajab bate
Ada tohar alag lage
Heroine ke figure bate
Pura Bombay ke khabar bate

Hinglish Translation:
Tumhara nasha bada gajab ka hai.
Tumhari ada sabse alag aur anokhi lagti hai.
Tumhara figure bilkul kisi heroine jaisa hai.
Pure Bombay me bas tumhari hi charcha (khabar) ho rahi hai.

CHORUS
Sapna me je dekhni uhe kahani lagelu
Goriya tu Bombay ke rani lagelu
Goriya tu Bombay ke rani lagelu
Kabho nahi ghate je jawani lagelu
Goriya tu Bombay ke Bombay ke Bombay ke

Hinglish Translation:
Jo tumhe sapno me dekhe, use tum kisi kahani jaisi lagti ho.
Gori ladki, tum toh Bombay ki rani jaisi lagti ho.
Gori ladki, tum toh Bombay ki rani jaisi lagti ho.
Tumhari jawani aisi hai jo kabhi kam (dhal) hi nahi hoti.
Gori ladki, tum toh sach me Bombay ki rani lagti ho.

VERSE 2
Dhoop me nikalna na gori tan ho jayi
Kahi na Nishant toharo fan ho jayi

Hinglish Translation:
Gori ladki, tum Bombay ki rani lagti ho.
Dhoop me mat nikla karo gori, nahi toh rang sanwla (tan) ho jayega.
Kahi Nishant bhi tumhara fan (deewana) na ban jaye.



Dekhila je tohke ham bechain ho jayin
Saans bharal gori na kahin ban ho jayi
Bharal jawani me gori pani me tu aag lagawelu
Rahelu Bombay gori, Patna me tu maar fasawelu

Hinglish Translation:
Jab bhi hum tumhe dekhte hain, bechain ho jaate hain.
Darr lagta hai ki kahin hamari saansein hi na ruk jayein.
Is khilti jawani me gori tum paani me bhi aag laga deti ho.
Rahti toh Bombay me ho gori, par hungama aur kangle-aam Patna me machati ho.

Pahinke LV, Gucci, Prada sbke brand dikhabelu
Nikallu hot je banke, Bandra me jaam laga dehlu

Hinglish Translation:
LV, Gucci aur Prada jaise bade brands pehan kar sabko style dikhati ho.
Jab tum itni hot ban kar nikalti ho, toh Bandra me traffic jam laga deti ho.

RAP
Neeli neeli akhiyan se jadu karelu
Hamra ke kahe bekabu karelu
Dil kare jor se dhak dhak dhak dhak dhak
Nishantwa ke babu kahelu

Are nazari se nazari milaike 
Rakha hamra k pas bulaike 
Tohre se karab biyah ae janu
Boldeni ham apan mai ke 
Bol deni ja

Hinglish Translation:
Apni neeli-neeli aankhon se tum jaadu karti ho.
Hame is tarah apne vash me (bekabu) kyu kar rahi ho?
Mera dil bahut zor-zor se dhak-dhak dhadakne lagta hai.
Jab tum Nishant ko pyaar se 'babu' kahkar bulati ho.
Tumne toh pyaar ka aisa rog laga diya hai.
Aakhon me aakhen dal kar mujhe apne pas baithakar rakho.
Tumse he shadi karunga apni maa ko bol chuka hu.      


VERSE 3
Lagailu ishq ke rog
Jagal rahi roj goriya
Ki ab har raat jaag kar hi beet-ti hai, gori.
Ham na manab hamke chahi love ke dose goriya
Dekhni Insta pe tor model wala pose goriya
Ki man karata ki kardi propose goriya
Bhaiya Ravi ke tu deewani lagelu
Goriya tu Bombay ke rani lagelu


Hinglish Translation:
Ab hum nahi maanenge, hame toh tumhare pyaar ki dose chahiye, gori.
Instagram pe humne tumhara model wala pose dekha hai, gori.
Usko dekh kar dil karta hai ki tumhe seedha propose kar dein, gori.
Tum toh Ravi bhaiya ki deewani lagti ho.
Gori ladki, tum toh Bombay ki rani lagti ho

snippet.title: Mangli Bathukamma Song 2026 | బతుకమ్మ పాట | Latest Telangana Folk Song | Bathukamma 2026
snippet.description:
Mangli Bathukamma Song 2026 | బతుకమ్మ పాట | Telangana Folk Song

Celebrate the spirit, tradition and colours of Telangana with Mangli’s special Bathukamma Song 2026. 💐✨

This latest Bathukamma Song brings together the festive energy of Bathukamma, the beauty of Telangana culture and the powerful folk voice of Mangli.

🌼 బతుకమ్మ పండుగ శుభాకాంక్షలు!
తెలంగాణ ఆడపడుచులందరికీ ఈ బతుకమ్మ పండుగ ఆనందం, ఆరోగ్యం, సంతోషాన్ని తీసుకురావాలని కోరుకుంటున్నాం. ❤️

CREDITS

Lead & Singer : mangli
Lyrics : Thirupathi matla
Music :  madeen sk 
DOP : Captainsaikiran
Editing : Raju Bodasingi
Choreographer : Sahana Shetty
DI : mahasabha studios 
Colorist : Thiru Kundella
Costumes : Varnam Collections
Executive : Meghwatt
Special Thanks : Kondal Yadav,
Gangada Village, Shankarpally


🎶 Song: Mangli Bathukamma Song 2026
🌸 Festival: Bathukamma 2026
🎤 Singer: Mangli
🎵 Genre: Telangana Folk / Telugu Folk
📍 Language: Telugu

ఈ పాటను మీ కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో కలిసి చూడండి, వినండి మరియు షేర్ చేయండి. ❤️

👍 Like | 💬 Comment | 🔔 Subscribe | ↗️ Share

మీకు ఈ Bathukamma Song 2026 నచ్చితే కామెంట్‌లో మీ అభిప్రాయం చెప్పండి.

 भक्त मानते हैं कि माँ शैलपुत्री की पूजा करने से मन में शांति, साहस, श्रद्धा और दृढ़ता का भाव जागता है। नवरात्रि में भक्त उनकी आराधना करके अपने परिवार की सुख-समृद्धि की कामना करते हैं।

snippet.title: The Top Spot Is Home 👑 | Semi-Finals Day 3 | TAG Vlog
snippet.description:
We said Day 2 was about staying consistent. Day 3 was about taking back what’s ours.

TAG is back at the top of the table, and the Grand Finals slot is almost in the bag. 👑

The squad walked in knowing exactly what was at stake, and they played like it. Fights taken on our terms, rotations that kept us a step ahead, and points stacking up game after game until the standings looked the way we wanted them to. #1 again.

The vlog has the full day: the focus in the green room, the big plays that pushed us up the table, the bench going loud after every key fight, and the moment the boys checked the standings and saw TAG at the top once more. A few smiles, a few hugs, and then straight back to business, because “almost” isn’t “done.” 😤

Look at the run so far. A tough Upper Bracket Day 2. A last-match WWCD miracle to reach the semis. Top of the table on Day 1, steady on Day 2, and back at #1 today. This squad has been building toward something, and the finish line is right there.

One last push. 🏆

Drop a 👑 if you think TAG is walking into the Grand Finals as the team to beat, and tell us in the comments your favourite moment of the semis so far.

Subscribe for the next vlog. If all goes to plan, it’s the one where we book our ticket.

snippet.title: नवरात्रि आरती - जय अम्बे गौरी Jai Ambe Gauri | Durga Ji Ki Aarti | Durga Maa Song | Navratri Song
snippet.description:
Perform the most sacred and auspicious worship of Adishakti Maa Durga on the holy occasion of Navratri with the timeless devotional prayer, "Jai Ambe Gauri" (जय अम्बे गौरी). Revered as the definitive Durga Ji Ki Aarti across millions of households, this divine hymn purifies your surroundings, removes negative vibrations, and fills your heart and home with pure positive energy, maternal grace, and spiritual radiance.

Singing and listening to "Jai Ambe Gauri" during morning and evening puja invokes the supreme presence and loving protection of Maa Ambe. As the eternal consort of Lord Shiva and the supreme cosmic nurturer, Mother Gauri dispels fear, worldly suffering, and domestic discord, blessing her devotees with good health, family harmony, and boundless prosperity.

Spiritual Significance & Meaning:
"जय अम्बे गौरी, मैया जय श्यामा गौरी | तुमको निसदिन ध्यावत, हरि ब्रह्मा शिवरी ||"
This revered Aarti celebrates the multifaceted cosmic glory of the Divine Mother—worshipped continuously by Brahma, Vishnu, and Mahesh. Waving the sacred deepam (lamp) while offering this Aarti cleanses the spiritual atmosphere of your dwelling, awakens inner peace, and brings heartfelt fulfillment to all prayers.

Key Benefits of Chanting & Listening:
• Clears away negative energies, evil eyes, and domestic distress.
• Brings profound peace, harmony, and auspicious blessings to your household.
• Infuses your home with vibrant Navratri festive energy and divine light.
• Bestows the benevolent grace, protection, and prosperity of Maa Durga and Maa Gauri.
• Serves as the quintessential morning and evening Aarti for daily puja and Navratri celebrations.

Title :- Om Jai Ambe Gauri
Singer :- Varsha Shrivastava
Music :- Vijay Nanda
Video Supervision :- Chetan Garud

✨ आरती के बोल:
|| जय अम्बे गौरी आरती ||

जय अम्बे गौरी, मैया जय श्यामा गौरी।  
तुमको निशदिन ध्यावत, हरि ब्रह्मा शिव री॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Jai Ambe Gauri, Maiya Jai Shyama Gauri.  
Tumko Nishdin Dhyavat, Hari Brahma Shiv Ri.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri.  

मांग सिंदूर विराजत, टीको मृगमद को।  
उज्जवल से दोऊ नैना, चन्द्रबदन नीको॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Maang Sindoor Virajat, Teeko Mrigmad Ko.  
Ujjval Se Dou Naina, Chandr Badan Neeko.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri. 

कनक समान कलेवर, रक्ताम्बर राजे।  
रक्तपुष्प गलमाला, कण्ठन पर साजे॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Kanak Samaan Kalevar, Raktambar Raje.  
Raktpushp Galmala, Kanthan Par Saje.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri.  

केहरि वाहन राजत, खड्ग खप्परधारी।  
सुर नर मुनिजन सेवत, तिनके दुखहारी॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Kehari Vahan Rajat, Khadg Khappar Dhaari.  
Sur Nar Munijan Sevat, Tinke Dukhhaari.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri. 

कानन कुण्डल शोभित, नासाग्रे मोती।  
कोटिक चन्द्र दिवाकर, राजत सम ज्योती॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Kanan Kundal Shobhit, Naasaagre Moti.  
Kotik Chandra Divakar, Rajat Sam Jyoti.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri.  

शुम्भ-निशुम्भ विधंशिनी, महिषासुर घाती।  
धूम्र विलोचन नैना, निशदिन मदमाती॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Shumbh-Nishumbh Vidhanashini, Mahishasur Ghati.  
Dhoomra Vilochan Naina, Nishdin Madmaati.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri.

चण्ड-मुण्ड संहारिणी, रक्तबीज हारी।  
मुण्डमाल शोभित तन, जय जय त्रिपुरारी॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Chand-Mund Sanharini, Raktabeej Haari.  
Mundmal Shobhit Tan, Jai Jai Tripuraari.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri. 

लक्ष्मी जी पद विराजत, गंगे करधारी।  
त्रिभुवन सुखदानी, मैया जातो बलिहारी॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Lakshmi Ji Pad Virajat, Gange Kar Dhaari.  
Tribhuvan Sukhdaani, Maiya Jaato Balihaari.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri. 

तुम ही आदि भवानी, तुम ही जगदधारी।  
त्रिगुण स्वरूपिनी मैया, जग पालन कारी॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Tum Hi Aadi Bhavani, Tum Hi Jagad Dhaari.  
Trigun Swaroopini Maiya, Jag Palan Kaari.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri.  

मनवांछित फल पावत, सेवत नर नारी।  
सब सुख संपत्ति पाते, दुख नशे रोग हारी॥  
ॐ जय अम्बे गौरी॥

Manvanchit Phal Paavat, Sevat Nar Naari.  
Sab Sukh Sampatti Paate, Dukh Nashe Rog Haari.  
Om Jai Ambe Gauri.

snippet.title: Mahishasuramardini - Mahalaya | মহালয়া | Birendra Krishna Bhadra | Pankaj Mullick | Bani Kumar
snippet.description:
শিউলির গন্ধ, ভোরের আকাশে কাশফুলের দোলা আর চণ্ডীপাঠের পবিত্র আবহ—মহালয়ার ভোর মানেই বাঙালির মনে দুর্গাপুজোর আগমনী সুর। 🙏✨

মা দুর্গার মর্ত্যে আগমনকে স্বাগত জানিয়ে মহালয়ার এই শুভক্ষণে শুনুন ‘মহিষাসুরমর্দিনী’—শক্তি, ভক্তি ও আধ্যাত্মিকতার এক অনন্য পরিবেশনা। দেবী দুর্গার অসুরবধ ও শুভশক্তির জয়ের কাহিনি আজও প্রতিটি বাঙালির হৃদয়ে জাগিয়ে তোলে ভক্তি ও আবেগ।

Script : Bani Kumar Music Director : Pankaj Kumar Mallick Narration & Chanting of Slokas - Birendra Krishna Bhadra Singers - Supreeti Ghosh, Dwijen Mukherjee, Sumitra Sen, Krishna Dasgupta, Pankaj Mallick, Utpala Sen, Sandhya Mukherjee, Pratima Mukherjee, Tarun Banerjee & Others 

Mahalaya, signifies the termination of Pitri Paksha and the beginning of Devi Paksha, thus ushering in the season of religious festivals. It is said that Devi Durga begins her journey from her husband's abode in Kailash to her paternal home on this day. The glory of Durga is known from the ancient treatise Durga Saptasati or the Chandi. It describes the incarnation of Devi Durga by the unification process of all the power of the Gods and her emergence as Mahisasuramardini in the eventual fight with Mahisasura. Recitation of these slokas is known as Chandi Path and has been recited and known to combat every kind of enmity and adversity, from ages forgotten. Since the early 1930s, homes in Bengal reverberate with the immortal verses from Chandi Kabya in the recorded voice of late Birendra Krishna Bhadra. It is a beautiful audio montage of recitation in the enthralling voice of Birendra Krishna Bhadra, Bengali devotional songs with narration scripted by Bani Kumar, classical music composed by Pankaj Kumar Mullick and a dash of acoustic melodrama.
